thread:
Irene K: Quick sync — Valerian private cutover is set for tomorrow. Need final owners for egress/NAT, airgap image push, and the onprem smoke window. Who's taking Ambassador egress hop?
Sam P: I'll take Ambassador egress. I'll validate route table, SNI passthrough, and run the smoke checks. Ping me for CR numbers.
Kevin L: I have the NAT fallback config ready, but we need network ACL approval from @Priya_S before enabling.
Priya S: Ack — reviewing ACLs now, will post approvals by EOD. One Q: does Valerian want outbound TLS inspection off for the first 24h?
Anya R: Confirmed with the customer security lead — they requested no TLS inspection for the initial cutover.
Chris M: For airgap image push I need a signed manifest + full sha256. @Sam_P can you share the artifact path and hash?
Sam P: Artifact: s3://redwood-uploads/valerian/airgap/2026-03-20/amb.tar.gz
Sam P: sha256: 3f7b9d2a5c9e8a1f2b6c4d7e8a9f0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7 (DMing full)
devops-bot: deploy-schedule: blackout window set Sat 02:00-05:00 UTC. Oncall: @kevin_l
Kevin L: I'll be oncall for the window. Please freeze rolling restarts and any infra upgrades during that period.
Irene K: Action items summary — Sam: Ambassador smoke + artifact handoff; Priya: ACL signoff; Kevin: NAT + oncall; Chris: manifest verify + push. Reply with 'done' when complete. Also need a CR reviewer — @anya_r can you handle the network CR review?
Anya R: Yep, I'll review the CR this afternoon. If ACLs look good I'll approve.
Priya S: ACL approved, CR0004325 attached: https://confluence.redwood/CR/4325 :thumbsup:
Sam P: Staging smoke tests passing. Quick log excerpt: ```curl -s http://amb-host/health | jq .status -> "ok"``` Promoting after Priya approves.
Chris M: Manifest verified and pushed to airgap-staging repo. Posted checksum in DM.
Irene K: Thanks all. Final ask — please leave a one-line note in #eng-oncall when you finish so ops has the handoff record. I'll check in morning if anything's still open.
